{"code": "import numpy as np

# Re-run the missingness analysis with correct syntax and handling of boolean series
missing_mask = data['biomarker_baseline'].isnull()

# Count total and missing
count_total = len(data)
count_missing = missing_mask.sum()
print(f'Total patients: {count_total}')
print(f'Missing baseline: {count_missing} ({count_missing / count_total * 100:.1f}%)')

# Check missingness by arm
missing_by_arm = data.groupby('arm', observed=True)[missing_mask].sum()
total_by_arm = data.groupby('arm', observed=True).size()
missing_rate_by_arm = missing_by_arm / total_by_arm
print('\nMissing rate by arm:')
print(missing_rate_by_arm)

# Check by severity
missing_by_severity = data.groupby('severity', observed=True)[missing_mask].sum()
total_by_severity = data.groupby('severity', observed=True).size()
missing_rate_by_severity = missing_by_severity / total_by_severity
print('\nMissing rate by severity:')
print(missing_rate_by_severity)

# Check by sex
missing_by_sex = data.groupby('sex', observed=True)[missing_mask].sum()
total_by_sex = data.groupby('sex', observed=True).size()
missing_rate_by_sex = missing_by_sex / total_by_sex
print('\nMissing rate by sex:')
print(missing_rate_by_sex)

# Check by age group
age_bins = [0, 40, 60, 80, 100]
age_labels = ['<40', '40-60', '60-80', '80+']
data['age_group'] = pd.cut(data['age'], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, right=False)
missing_by_age = data.groupby('age_group', observed=True)[missing_mask].sum()
total_by_age = data.groupby('age_group', observed=True).size()
missing_rate_by_age = missing_by_age / total_by_age
print('\nMissing rate by age group:')
print(missing_rate_by_age)

# Drop the temporary age_group column
data.drop(columns=['age_group'], inplace=True)"}
